work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 哭擗 … 立喪主

items.text: Wail and beat the breast without number.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終 · 哭擗 … 立喪主
items.quote: 男女，哭擗，無數。 — Men and women, wail and beat the breast without number.

items.text: Act as chief mourner and present the offerings; if there is no eldest son, the eldest grandson takes this duty.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終 · 哭擗 … 立喪主
items.quote: 主人謂長子。無則長孫承重，以奉饋奠。 — The master of rites is the eldest son; if none, the eldest grandson bears the weight and ministers the offerings.
items.conflict: Giving food to the dead treats them as needing sustenance; honor the dead without such offerings.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 復

items.text: Perform the rite of summoning the soul, for it is the way to exhaust love for the parent.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·復
items.quote: 復，盡愛之道也，有禱祀之心焉
items.conflict: Dead cannot return; soul is not to be summoned (Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: During the summoning rite, briefly stop wailing so that the soul may return without hindrance.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·復
items.quote: 復時，宜令孝子，暫時輟哭，以全望返之誠
items.conflict: Dead cannot return; soul is not to be summoned (Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: Climb onto the roof holding the deceased's upper garment, face north, and call the deceased's name three times, then cover the corpse with it.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·復
items.quote: 升屋中霤，北面，招以衣，三呼曰，『某人，復。』
items.conflict: Dead cannot return; soul is not to be summoned (Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: Do not use the garment used for summoning the soul to dress or encoffin the body.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·復
items.quote: 復衣，不以衣尸，不以斂
items.conflict: Part of non-biblical soul-summoning rite; no such garment rules.

items.text: Place the garment used for summoning the soul on the spirit seat or in the soul-cloth box after the rite.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·復
items.quote: 復衣，置靈座，恐無妨
items.conflict: Part of non-biblical soul-summoning rite; no such garment rules.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 陳襲衣

items.text: Prepare the burial garments for the deceased and lay them out according to the prescribed rites, using the silk head-wrap, ear plugs, face covering, and hand wraps.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 陳襲衣
items.quote: 以卓子陳于堂前東壁下，西領南上。 — Place the table before the east wall of the hall, collars to the west, best items to the south.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 具括髮麻免布髽麻

items.text: For a mother, even in the lesser mourning grade, use hemp for the hair binding to honor her.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 具括髮麻免布髽麻
items.quote: 爲母雖齊衰，亦用麻 — For a mother, even in the lesser mourning grade, use hemp.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 陳絰帶

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 侍者卒襲覆以衾 … 並有喪襲斂先後

items.text: Prepare the dead for burial by dressing them in the prescribed garments and coverings, following the rites with care.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7 襲
items.quote: 加幅巾充耳，設幎目納履，乃襲深衣，結大帶，設握手，乃覆以衾。 — Put on the hood and ear plugs, set the face covering and put on shoes, then dress him in the deep robe, tie the large sash, set the hand coverings, and cover with the quilt.

items.text: When there are multiple deaths, give precedence in dressing and coffining to the more senior deceased, following the order of generation and rank.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7 襲
items.quote: 襲斂與窆葬，有異。不可以先輕後重爲拘，當以尊卑爲主而先祖後父。 — Dressing and burial differ; do not be bound by 'light before heavy', but take seniority as the main principle, and put the grandfather before the father.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 不食

items.text: When your parent dies, go without food and drink for three days.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 不食
items.quote: 諸子三日不食。水漿，不入口，三日 — All sons do not eat for three days; for three days, let no water or liquid enter the mouth.

items.text: Fast according to the mourning grade: for a one-year or nine-month mourning, go without food three times; for a five-month or three-month mourning, go without food twice.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 不食
items.quote: 朞九月之喪，三不食，五月三月之喪，再不食 — For one-year and nine-month mourning, three times do not eat; for five-month and three-month mourning, two times do not eat.

items.text: Prepare gruel for the fasting sons so they may eat after mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 不食
items.quote: 親戚隣里，爲糜粥以食之 — Relatives and neighbors make gruel to feed them.

items.text: As an elder, urge the mourning son to take a little food.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 不食
items.quote: 尊長强之，少食，可也 — If elders force them, eating a little is permissible.

items.text: When your eldest son dies, do not eat even porridge.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 不食
items.quote: 父爲長子，不食粥 — A father for his eldest son does not eat porridge.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 總論 · 總論 總 … 喪具稱家有無

items.text: While mourning your parent, avoid fine clothes, music, and rich food, and let your grief be sincere.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 服美不安，聞樂不樂，食旨不甘 — not comfortable in fine clothes, not pleased by music, not savoring rich food

items.text: Do not let mourning for your parent destroy your life; after three days eat, and do not allow grief to ruin your health.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 三日而食，敎民無以死傷生，毁不滅性 — after three days eat, teaching not to injure the living for the dead, destruction not destroying nature

items.text: Mourn your parent for a set period, not beyond three years, so that love and respect have a measured limit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 喪不過三年，示民有終也 — mourning does not exceed three years, showing the people there is an end

items.text: Give your parent a proper coffin (inner and outer) and burial clothes, and place the body in the coffin.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 爲之棺槨衣衾而擧之 — make for them inner and outer coffins, burial clothes, and raise the body

items.text: Set out sacrificial vessels of food for your departed parent and mourn over them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 陳其簠簋而哀戚之 — display the vessels and grieve over them
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead conflict with the prohibition of necromancy and with worship due to God alone (Deut 18:11; Isa 8:19).

items.text: Choose the burial ground by divination and lay your parent's body to rest there.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 卜其宅兆而安厝之 — divine the burial site and lay them to rest
items.conflict: Divination is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12); burial site should not be chosen by omens.

items.text: After burial, build an ancestral shrine and make offerings to your parent's spirit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 爲之宗廟，以鬼享之 — make for them an ancestral temple, and offer to them as ghosts
items.conflict: Worship of ancestors as spirits conflicts with the worship of the one true God (Exod 20:3-5); the dead do not receive such offerings.

items.text: As your parents grow old, prepare their funeral necessities step by step: at 60 prepare the coffin, at 70 prepare seasonal clothes, at 80 monthly, at 90 daily repair; only the shroud, quilt, and face cover are made after death.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 六十歲制，七十時制，八十月制，九十日修。惟絞紟衾冒，死而后制 — at sixty prepare by the year, at seventy by the season, at eighty by the month, at ninety by the day; only the shroud, quilt, and cover are made after death

items.text: Give funeral goods in proportion to your family's wealth: if rich, do not go beyond what is fitting; if poor, simply wrap the body and bury it without delay, and no one will criticize you.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 稱家之有無 — according to the family's having or not having

items.text: Do not sell your house to pay for funeral expenses, for you must keep a home for the ancestral shrine.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 喪不慮居，爲無廟也 — in mourning do not consider selling the dwelling, because of having no temple

items.text: While your parent is alive, care for them with whatever you have, even if it is only beans and water, and bring them joy.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 啜菽飮水，盡其歡，斯之謂孝 — sip beans and drink water, exhaust their joy, this is called filial piety

items.text: If you have the means, do not be stingy in your parent's funeral; do not withhold proper expenses from your parent for the sake of worldly gain.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7.總論 喪具稱家有無
items.quote: 君子，不以天下，儉其親 — a gentleman does not, for the sake of the world, stint his parent

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 立銘旌

items.text: Make a name banner for the deceased and set it at the right of the soul seat.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin 7, 立銘旌
items.quote: 以絳帛爲銘旌，倚於靈座之右 — Make the name banner of red silk and lean it at the right of the soul seat.

items.text: Write on the banner the deceased's name and title exactly as he was called in life, not adding or subtracting.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin 7, 立銘旌
items.quote: 書銘于末，曰『某氏某之柩』 — Write on the end: 'The coffin of Mr. So-and-so.'

items.text: For a deceased wife, write her title according to her husband's office.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin 7, 立銘旌
items.quote: 婦人封號從夫職 — A wife's title follows her husband's office.

items.text: If the name banner becomes defaced, rewrite it so that the name remains clear.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin 7, 立銘旌
items.quote: 銘旌色渝當改 — If the name banner's color fades, it should be changed.

items.text: Do not add honorary titles; write only the real office and name.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin 7, 立銘旌
items.quote: 只書實職，恐當 — Write only the actual office, I think.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 襚禮 … 古者鑿木爲重

items.text: Provide burial clothes for the deceased; close relatives give without formal announcement because they share property.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7. 襲. 襲. 襚禮
items.quote: 親者襚，不將命，以卽陳。（註：大功以上，有同財之義也。）

items.text: Prepare a soul cloth or spirit tablet for the deceased and set before it a table with incense, wine, and fruit to house the spirit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7. 襲. 襲. 襚禮 … 古者鑿木爲重
items.quote: 結白絹爲魂帛，置椅上。設香爐盒盞注酒果於卓子上。
items.conflict: Making an image or tablet to house a spirit and offering to it is ancestor worship, forbidden by the first two commandments.

items.text: Morning and evening set out comb, washbasin, and daily necessities for the deceased as when he was alive.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7. 襲. 襲. 襚禮 … 古者鑿木爲重
items.quote: 侍者朝夕設櫛頮奉養之具，皆如平生。
items.conflict: This treats the dead as needing physical care, contrary to the doctrine that the souls of the faithful are with Christ and not served by human hands.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 陳襲衣

items.text: Clothe the departed with the prescribed three layers of garments, inner garment, sash, shoes, and outer coverings, using the specified materials and colors.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 陳襲衣
items.quote: 三稱服 — Three layers of garments

items.text: Give the departed the number of shrouds due to their rank: three for those of higher rank, one for those of lower.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 陳襲衣
items.quote: 五品以上，襲三稱，六品以下，襲一稱 — Fifth rank and above, three layers; sixth rank and below, one layer

items.text: Cover the body with the outer wrapper (冒) from the time of dressing until the lesser encoffining, so that the body's form is not exposed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 陳襲衣
items.quote: 自襲以至小斂，不設冒則形 — From dressing to lesser encoffining, without wrapper the shape is seen

items.text: Display extra shrouds as a mark of honor, but use only the prescribed few for dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 陳襲衣
items.quote: 庶襚繼陳，不用 — Extra shrouds are laid out but not used

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 疾病 … 旣絶乃哭

items.text: When he is sick, move him to the main room to die properly; if it is bitterly cold, obey his own wish.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 凡疾病，遷居正寢。 — When there is illness, move to the proper room.

items.text: Pray to the household gods for his recovery, but not with corrupt later rites; follow the pattern of Zhou Gong and Yu Qianlou.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 行禱于五祀 — pray to the five household spirits
items.conflict: First Commandment: pray to God alone, not to household spirits.

items.text: When he is ill, stand a few steps away; a man must not die attended by a woman.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 婦人侍疾者，雖至親，當處數步之外 — When a woman attends the sick, even a close relative, she must stand a few steps away

items.text: When she is ill, stand a few steps away; a woman must not die attended by a man.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 婦人疾病，男子亦然 — When a woman is ill, the man likewise

items.text: On his death, wail with a broken voice; let brothers weep aloud.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 主人啼，兄弟哭 — The master wails, brothers weep

items.text: If his deathbed command is the result of a disordered mind, do not carry it out; follow what he said when clear.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 疾病則亂。吾從其治也。 — In sickness his mind is disordered; I follow his clear command.

items.text: Record the sick person's last words in writing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 問病者有何言，有則書于紙 — Ask what the sick person says, and write it down on paper

items.text: When he is sick, remove music, sweep the house, and keep quiet; do not cry or rush about.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 徹琴瑟，悲哀哭泣，傷病者心 — Remove lutes; sad weeping wounds the sick one's heart

items.text: Place him so his head is to the east under the north wall, that he may face the source of life.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 寢東首于北墉下 — Sleep with head to east under the north wall

items.text: When caring for a sick person, take off mourning garments, for seeking life is incompatible with signs of death.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites 7
items.quote: 養有疾者，不喪服 — When caring for the sick, do not wear mourning garments

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 治棺

items.text: Provide a coffin of good wood: choose oil fir, cedar, or similar durable wood, and make it strong and long-lasting.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 擇木爲棺。油杉爲上，柏次之，土杉爲下。 — Choose wood for the coffin: oil fir is best, cedar next, local fir lowest.

items.text: Make the coffin appropriately sized: square and straight, head larger, foot smaller, just fitting the body; do not make it too tall or too large, and avoid false eaves and high feet.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 其制方直，頭大足小，僅取容身。勿令高大，及爲虛簷高足。 — Its shape square and straight, head larger, foot smaller, just fitting the body; do not make it too tall or large, nor add false eaves and high feet.

items.text: Use heartwood for the coffin boards, removing all white sapwood so the boards will not rot, and join them securely.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 松木，白邊，則毁爛如土，黃腸，則歲久不朽，木理不解，縫隙亦無獨先朽破。以此觀之，則如不得黃腸全板，須盡斫去白邊，連接爲板，爲好。 — Pine wood with white sapwood rots like earth, but yellow heartwood lasts long without rotting, its grain does not split, and seams do not rot first. Therefore, if you cannot get a full board of yellow heartwood, you must cut away all the white sapwood and join the heartwood into boards, which is good.

items.text: Coat the coffin inside and out with lacquer mixed with ash to seal and strengthen it.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 內外皆用灰漆。 — Inside and out, use ash-lacquer.

items.text: Seal the coffin's seams with pine resin (asphalt), especially between the coffin and outer coffin, to make it watertight and durable.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 內用瀝靑溶瀉，厚半寸以上。 — Inside, pour melted pine resin to a thickness of half an inch or more.

items.text: Line the inside of the coffin with black cloth (or paper if poor), and use green silk for the four corners if you are a high official.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 裏棺，用玄綠，用牛骨鐕...黑繒，或紬或綿布。無財，用紙以塗棺內四方。 — Line the coffin with black and green cloth, using ox-bone nails... use black silk, or pongee or cotton cloth; if without means, use paper to cover the four sides inside the coffin.

items.text: Spread cooked millet ash on the bottom of the coffin to a thickness of four inches to absorb moisture and deter insects.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 以煉熟秫米灰，鋪其底，厚四寸許。 — Spread well-cooked millet ash on the bottom to a thickness of about four inches.

items.text: Place the Seven Stars board in the coffin, with seven holes arranged like the Big Dipper, because the Northern Dipper governs death.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 加七星板。板上穿七孔，如北斗狀...南斗司生，北斗司死故也。 — Add the Seven Stars board. Pierce seven holes in the board like the Big Dipper... because the Southern Dipper governs life and the Northern Dipper governs death.
items.conflict: Astral symbolism, astrology

items.text: Attach large iron rings to the four bottom corners of the coffin, and use ropes through them to lift and carry the coffin.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Chojong, Jigwan
items.quote: 底四隅各釘大鐵環，動則以大索貫而擧之。 — Nail large iron rings to the four bottom corners; when moving it, thread large ropes through them and lift.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 訃告于親戚僚友

items.text: Announce the death to your relatives; if no funeral director, do it yourself.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·訃告于親戚僚友
items.quote: 若無，則主人自訃親戚，不訃僚友。 — If there is no [director], the master himself announces to relatives, not to colleagues.

items.text: Send a messenger to announce the death to the ruler and bow as he departs.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·訃告于親戚僚友
items.quote: 乃赴于君。主人西階東，南面命赴者，拜送。 — Go inform the ruler. The master, east of the western steps, facing south, orders the messenger and bows him off.

items.text: When a death occurs in the family, announce it to the clan; when the one-year and second-year sacrifices come, inform them as well.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 初終·訃告于親戚僚友
items.quote: 死必赴，練祥則告。 — At death you must announce; at the one-year and second-year sacrifices, inform.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 相禮 … 易服

items.text: When a parent dies, remove your cap and outer garment, let your hair down, and if male, tuck up the front of your robe and go barefoot; but if you have been made heir to another line or are a married daughter, do not let your hair down or go barefoot.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 初終 · 相禮 … 易服
items.quote: 妻子婦妾，皆去冠及上服被髮，男子，扱上衽，徒跣。為人後者爲本生父母，及女子已嫁者，皆不被髮徒跣。

items.text: When your husband dies, remove your cap and outer garment and let your hair down, as prescribed for the immediate family.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 初終 · 相禮 … 易服
items.quote: 妻子婦妾，皆去冠及上服被髮

items.text: When a parent-in-law dies, remove your cap and outer garment and let your hair down, as the immediate family does.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 初終 · 相禮 … 易服
items.quote: 妻子婦妾，皆去冠及上服被髮

items.text: Remove all ornate adornments—brocade, red or purple, gold, jade, pearls and kingfisher feathers—when in mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 初終 · 相禮 … 易服
items.quote: 有服者，皆去華飾，謂錦繡紅紫金玉珠翠之類。

items.text: When a parent dies, go to the waterside with loose hair, weep, throw coins and paper money into the water, then draw water to wash the corpse; otherwise you will be called unfilial.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 初終 · 相禮 … 易服
items.quote: 親始死，被髮持甁甕，慟哭於水濱，擲銅錢紙錢於水，汲歸浴尸，謂之買水，否則隣里謂之不孝。
items.conflict: Throwing coins and paper money as offerings to spirits is superstitious and idolatrous; worship God alone (Deut 18:10-12).

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 婦人襲具 … 沐浴飯含之具

items.text: Wash the body of the deceased with water and rice water.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 沐浴 — washing

items.text: Fill the mouth of the deceased with rice and three coins.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 士之子親含 — the son of a scholar does the mouth-filling himself

items.text: Clothe the deceased in garments proper to their sex and station.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 女喪，亦當不襲男服 — for a woman's funeral, she should not be dressed in men's clothes

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 乃沐浴 … 主人以下爲位哭

items.text: Do not be present while the corpse is bathed; go out of the curtain as you would have done when they were alive.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 主人以下，皆出帷外北面。… 象平生沐浴裸裎，子孫不在旁。

items.text: Dispose of the bath water, towel, and comb in a pit so they will not be profaned.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 沐浴餘水並巾櫛，棄于坎而埋之。… 已經尸用，恐人褻之，故棄于坎。

items.text: During the three-year mourning, sleep beside the corpse on a straw mat and earth block at night; do not seek soft bedding.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 三年之喪，夜則寢於尸旁，藉藁枕塊。

items.text: Those in mourning of a year or less should sleep nearby in the mourning place.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 朞以下，寢於側近。

items.text: Keep men and women in separate rooms while keeping vigil over the dead.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 男女異室。

items.text: Let elder relatives sit on cushions while you sit on straw; yield comfort to your seniors.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 尊行以長幼坐于牀東北壁下，南向西上，藉以席薦。

items.text: Take your place east of the bed, and let the mistress take the west; each lead your side in mourning order.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mourning
items.quote: 主人坐於牀東奠北。… 主婦衆婦女坐于牀西

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 徹帷 … 憑尸哭擗

items.text: When your wife dies, hold her garment over her heart and weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 夫於妻執之 — The husband holds her garment.

items.text: When your husband dies, gently draw the collar of his garment and weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 妻於夫拘之 — The wife gently draws his garment.

items.text: When your child dies, hold his garment over his heart and weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 父母於子執之 — Parents hold their child's garment.

items.text: When your parent dies, lean on his chest and weep with loud cries and beating of the breast.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 子於父母馮之 — The child leans on the parent's chest.

items.text: When your parent-in-law dies, lift his garment over his heart as a mark of honor and weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 婦於舅姑奉之 — The daughter-in-law lifts the garment respectfully.

items.text: When your daughter-in-law dies, stroke her body lightly and weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 舅姑於婦撫之 — Parents-in-law stroke her body.

items.text: When your brother dies, hold his garment over his heart and weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 夫於昆弟執之 — The man holds his brother's garment.

items.text: Do not stroke the corpse of your brother-in-law or sister-in-law; keep a respectful distance and mourn.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 憑尸哭擗
items.quote: 嫂不撫叔，叔不撫嫂 — The sister-in-law does not stroke the brother-in-law, nor he her.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 乃飯含 … 主人襲復位

items.text: Place rice and a coin in the mouth of your deceased parent, not leaving it empty.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 7, 襲 · 襲 · 乃飯含 … 主人襲復位
items.quote: 夫雖主喪，飯含則子當爲之，蓋人子不忍虛其口之義重也 — Although the husband presides over the funeral, the son should perform the rice-and-coin rite, because the principle that a child cannot bear to leave the mouth empty is weighty.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論

items.text: Make and wear mourning garments that express your grief according to your kinship with the dead.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, S?ngbok ch?ngnon
items.quote: 死者旣喪，生人制服，服之者，貌以表心，服以表貌。 — When the dead have been mourned, the living make mourning garments; by wearing them, the face expresses the heart, the garments express the face.

items.text: In mourning your parents, wear the same mourning clothes as every child, regardless of your own rank.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, S?ngbok ch?ngnon
items.quote: 端衰，無等。孝子於親，一也。 — The mourning garment knows no rank; a filial child's duty to parents is one.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪

items.text: Serve as the principal woman mourner (主婦) at your husband's funeral, standing in his wife's place.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 主婦，亡者之妻。 — The principal woman mourner is the wife of the deceased.

items.text: If the deceased has no wife, then as the wife of the chief mourner, serve as principal woman mourner at the funeral of your parent-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 無則主喪者之妻。 — If there is none, then the wife of the chief mourner.

items.text: Bear the heavy responsibility of chief mourner at a grandparent's funeral when your father is dead, even if uncles are present.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 祖在父亡，祖母死，亦承重。 — When the grandfather is alive but the father is dead, and the grandmother dies, [the eldest grandson] also bears the heavy responsibility.

items.text: When you are the father and still alive, preside as chief mourner at every funeral in the household, for the honor goes to the senior.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 凡喪，父在，父爲主。 — In all mourning, when the father is present, the father is the chief mourner.

items.text: As father-in-law, preside over the 祔 rite that installs the spirit tablet of your deceased daughter-in-law in the ancestral shrine.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 祔則舅主之。 — For the 祔 rite, the father-in-law presides.

items.text: Do not serve as chief mourner at the funeral of a son born of a concubine; let his own son or wife manage the rites.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 父不主庶子之喪。 — The father does not preside over the funeral of a son born of a concubine.
items.conflict: Treating children of concubines differently conflicts with Galatians 3:28; in Christ all are one, and children of a secondary union are not to be diminished.

items.text: Preside over the funeral rites of your mother, if she was a concubine, and do not hold the coffin in the main hall.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 主妾之喪，則自祔，至於練祥，皆使其子，主之。 — For the funeral of a concubine, from the 祔 rite through the 練 and 祥 rites, have her son preside.
items.conflict: The whole system of concubinage and its distinctions is contrary to the creation order of one man and one woman (Genesis 2:24; 1 Corinthians 7:2).

items.text: As grandfather, preside over the funeral of your grandchild if your son (the child's father) is alive, since all honors go to the senior.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 子有妻子之喪，父主之。 — When a son has mourning for his wife or child, his father presides.

items.text: If your brother dies leaving a minor son, serve as chief mourner through the end of mourning and carry the child for the bows.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 兄弟主之，至於終喪。其子則以衰抱之，人爲之拜。 — The brothers preside until the end of mourning; they carry the child in mourning clothes and bow on his behalf.

items.text: When a kinsman dies without an heir, do not leave him without a chief mourner; let a male of the same surname preside.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 男主，必使同姓。 — The chief male mourner must be of the same surname.

items.text: Do not take the role of chief mourner at your husband's funeral, for a woman does not preside over mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 婦人，無主喪之義。 — A woman has no duty to preside over mourning.

items.text: Appoint a son or younger brother who knows the rites and is capable as funeral manager (護喪), and let all funeral matters be referred to him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷七 · 初終 · 初終 · 主婦 … 護喪
items.quote: 以子弟知禮能幹者，爲之。凡喪事皆稟之。 — Appoint a son or younger brother who knows the rites and is capable; all funeral affairs are to be reported to him.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 乃奠 … 設燎

items.text: Weep with full grief as the body is laid out.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 主人以下哭盡哀 — The host and those below weep with full grief.

items.text: Bow twice before the spirit seat when the initial food offering is made.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 卑幼者，皆再拜 — The junior and young all bow twice.
items.conflict: Offering bows to the dead conflicts with the first commandment against other gods (Exodus 20:3).

items.text: Use undecorated vessels for the food offering, because your heart is plain with sorrow.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 奠以素器，以生者有哀素之心 — Use plain vessels for the offering, because the living have a heart of plain sorrow.
items.conflict: Food offerings to the dead conflict with biblical teaching against necromancy (Deuteronomy 18:11).

items.text: Wait until your parent is dressed and seated before making the bow of respect.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 孝子之事親也，必待父母衣服起坐，然後方行拜禮 — A filial son serving his parent must wait until his parents are dressed and seated, then perform the bow.

items.text: Take turns wailing through the night so that the voice does not cease, but do not use hired officials.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 乃代哭，不以官 — Then take turns wailing, not using officials.

items.text: Keep torches burning in the courtyard through the night, and put them out at dawn.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 宵爲燎于中庭，厥明滅燎 — At night make torches in the courtyard, at dawn extinguish the torches.

items.text: See mourners out with a bow at the gate.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 小斂 · 乃奠
items.quote: 賓出，主人拜送于門外 — When guests leave, the host bows and sends them off outside the gate.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 總 … 父

items.text: Mourn your father with the heaviest mourning (斬衰) for three full years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10.本宗服·父
items.quote: 斬衰：父。傳：爲父者，何以斬衰？父至尊也。 — For father, wear the unhemmed sackcloth. Why? Father is most exalted.

items.text: If you are an unmarried daughter, mourn your father with the heaviest mourning (斬衰) for three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10.本宗服·父
items.quote: 女子子在室，爲父三年。 — An unmarried daughter, for her father, three years.

items.text: As one taken as heir, mourn your adoptive father with the righteous mourning (義服) of 斬衰 for three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10.本宗服·父
items.quote: 爲所後父，義服，斬衰三年。 — For the adoptive father, wear the righteous mourning, unhemmed sackcloth, three years.

items.text: Even if married and widowed or childless, still mourn your parents, but for one year instead of three.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10.本宗服·父
items.quote: 適人無夫與子者，爲其父母猶服朞。 — A married woman without husband or children, for her parents still wears the one-year mourning.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯

items.text: Encoffin the body with care: wash hands, place the fallen hair and nails in the coffin corners, fill empty spaces with clothes, and put no gold, jade, or precious things inside.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 實生時所落齒髮及所翦爪于棺角。又揣其空缺處，卷衣塞之，務令充實，謹勿以金玉珍玩，寘棺中 — Place the hair and nails in the coffin corners; fill the empty spaces with clothes; do not put gold or jade within.

items.text: When moving the body or lifting the coffin, though you wail, also stop to inspect and make all secure, not only weep.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 凡動尸擧棺，哭擗無筭，然殯斂之際，亦當輟哭臨視，務令安固，不可但哭而已 — Whenever moving the body or lifting the coffin, wail, but during the encoffining stop crying and look, making it secure, not only weeping.

items.text: Do not overstuff the coffin or force the lid with many people or levers, lest you crush the body.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 或令數十人登踏，或挾木弩引而後，方得合，必有胸摧腹陷之患矣 — Or have scores of men stamp on it, or use wooden levers to force it shut, and so cause the chest to be crushed and the belly to cave in.

items.text: Lay the body with its head to the south, as if it were still alive, not as a spirit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 殯時，仍南首者，孝子猶若其生，不忍以神待之 — At the laying in the coffin, keep the head to the south, for the filial son still treats the dead as living, unable to treat them as spirits.

items.text: On the third day after death, encoffin the body, and let all that is placed on it be with sincerity and good faith, leaving no cause for regret.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 喪三日而殯。凡附於身者必誠必信，勿之有悔焉耳矣 — On the third day the body is coffined. Whatever is placed on the body must be with sincerity and trustworthiness, so that there is no regret.

items.text: When officials arrive late to condole, descend and bow to them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 主人降，拜大夫之後至者 — The master descended and bowed to the officials who arrived late.

items.text: Seal the coffin's seams, wrap it with an oiled covering, and bind it firmly with cords for safe handling.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 棺外四面隙處，以漆布塗之，或以菽末油紙塗之。裹以油芚...以索結之 — Seal the seams with lacquered cloth or oiled paper; wrap with an oiled covering; bind with cords.

items.text: After nailing the lid, remove the bier and cover the coffin with a cloth (the pall).
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 徹牀，覆柩以衣 — Remove the bed and cover the coffin with a cloth.

items.text: After the coffin is closed and the body hidden, remove the hair tufts you wore as a child, for the parent is gone.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 乃大斂 … 殯
items.quote: 旣殯，主人說髦 — After the interment, the master removed his hair tufts.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制 · 服制式假

items.text: Observe the death anniversary of your parents as a private memorial day, taking leave if in office.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Bokje Sikga
items.quote: 私忌在職非在職，祖父母父母並一日 — Private memorial days of grandparents and parents, whether in office or not, one day.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:11).

items.text: Observe the death anniversary of your grandparents as a private memorial day, taking leave if in office.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Bokje Sikga
items.quote: 私忌在職非在職，祖父母父母並一日 — Private memorial days of grandparents and parents, whether in office or not, one day.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:11).

items.text: Mourn your maternal grandparents and take the additional leave granted for their death.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Bokje Sikga
items.quote: 外祖父母，加給十五日 — Maternal grandparents, add fifteen days.

items.text: Mourn your wife's parents and take the additional leave granted for their death.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Bokje Sikga
items.quote: 妻父母，加給二十三日 — Wife's parents, add twenty-three days.

items.text: Attend the funeral of agnates and kin who lived with you, even if no mourning garment is worn.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Bokje Sikga
items.quote: 本宗及同居無服之親之喪一日 — For the funeral of agnates and cohabiting kin without mourning clothes, one day.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 三日而斂 … 擧棺入置于堂中少西

items.text: Wait until the third day after death to encoffin your parent, to allow time for revival, preparation, and the arrival of distant relatives.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 死三日而后斂者，以俟其生也。 — Encoffin after three days to wait for life.

items.text: Do not encoffin before the third day, since the parent might revive; to do so would be like killing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 未三日而斂，皆有殺之之理 — To encoffin before three days has the principle of killing.

items.text: Do not choose the encoffining day by yin-yang divination; if necessary, delay, but never allow the body to decay.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 世俗以陰陽拘忌，擇日而斂 — The vulgar, constrained by yin-yang taboos, choose a day.
items.conflict: Deuteronomy 18:10-12 forbids divination.

items.text: Provide a temporary place for the parent's spirit, moving the offering aside, so the spirit is not left without a resting place.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 爲求神於庭。孝子不忍使其親須臾無所憑依也 — Seeking the spirit in the courtyard; the filial son cannot bear his parent to be for a moment without something to rely on.

items.text: Prepare the encoffining garments, cords, and coverlets (including two wadded coverlets) as prescribed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 衾用有綿者... 絞，紟，衾二 — Use wadded coverlets; cords, sheet, two coverlets.

items.text: Prepare the coffin interior by spreading ash, white paper, the seven-star board, and bedding.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 鋪秫灰於棺中，使極均平，次鋪厚白紙，次下七星板，次鋪褥席 — Spread millet ash evenly, then thick white paper, then the seven-star board, then bedding.

items.text: If the deceased is a junior or minor, place the coffin in a separate room, not the main hall.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 若卑幼則於別室 — If a junior or minor, then in a separate room.

items.text: Place the coffin in the hall, slightly west, for the lying in state.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8
items.quote: 但於堂中少西而已 — Only place it in the middle of the hall, slightly west.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 · 母

items.text: Mourn your mother with the full three-year mourning when your father has already died.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 母
items.quote: 父卒則爲母 — When father has died, then for mother.

items.text: When your father is alive, wear the one-year mourning for your mother, and keep the heart-mourning for three years, abstaining from wine, meat, and the inner chamber.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 母
items.quote: 服雖除，而不飮酒，不食肉，不處內三者，居喪之實如故 — Although the mourning dress is removed, do not drink wine, eat meat, or stay in the inner quarters; the reality of mourning remains.

items.text: If adopted as heir within the three years, take up the remainder of the mourning for the deceased parent, not living in pleasure during that time.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 母
items.quote: 宜接其餘服，不可以吉居凶 — Continue the remaining mourning; do not live in pleasure during mourning.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服

items.text: For your husband, wear unhemmed coarse hemp as a large-sleeved jacket and long skirt, with cloth headband, bamboo hairpin, and hemp shoes; do not carry a staff.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 妻爲夫，布總箭笄髽衰，三年

items.text: For your lord, wear chamchoe with cloth band and arrow hairpin for three years; as a secondary wife, wear beuja instead of large sleeves.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 妾爲君，布總箭笄髽衰，三年

items.text: Wear unhemmed coarse hemp with cloth band, arrow hairpin, and exposed hair for three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 女子子在室爲父，布總箭笄髽衰，三年

items.text: For your parents-in-law, wear mourning of second-grade cloth; for your mother-in-law, hem the jacket and skirt; use a plain hairpin with a head and cloth band, and do not carry a staff.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 婦爲舅姑，惡笄有首，以髽布總

items.text: For your own parents, wear mourning with a plain hairpin with a head and cloth band; because you are married out, you do not carry a staff.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 女子子適人者，爲其父母，惡笄有首，以髽布總

items.text: Carry a staff of paulownia when mourning your eldest son.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 母爲長子，削杖

items.text: Mourn your master for three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 奴婢，爲其主，當爲三年

items.text: Do not mend a torn mourning garment; wear it as it is.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 苴衰，不補

items.text: If your mourning garment is lost, remake it without delay.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 婦人喪服制度 … 侍者喪服
items.quote: 遺失喪服，雖未盡旬月，不可作無服之人，改製，無疑

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 殯後哭位 … 止代哭者

items.text: Continue to set out daily food and bath offerings before the spirit seat as you did when he was alive.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 燕養饋羞，湯沐之饌，如他日 — Daily delicacies and bath provisions as on other days.
items.conflict: The dead do not eat; serving food implies they are present and need nourishment, which Scripture denies.

items.text: Dwell in a crude hut, sleep on straw and a clod, and do not remove your mourning garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 斬衰，寢苫，枕塊，不脫絰帶 — In deepest mourning, sleep on straw, pillow on a clod, and do not take off the headband and girdle.

items.text: Fast for the first three days of mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 生者三日不食 — The living do not eat for three days.

items.text: Abstain from conjugal relations during the mourning period prescribed for your parent or wife.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 朞，居廬，終喪，不御於內者 — For a year, live in the hut and do not go in to your wife until mourning ends.

items.text: After the coffin is sealed, wail at dawn and dusk and whenever grief rises; do not have others wail in your place.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 旣殯之後，朝夕及哀至，乃哭，不代哭 — After the encoffining, cry at dawn and dusk and when grief comes; do not substitute others to cry.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 · 長子婦 … 伯叔父母姑同

items.text: Mourn your eldest son's wife with one year's mourning as the principal daughter-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 嫡子婦舊服大功，請却爲周 — For the eldest son's wife, formerly wear great merit; request to change to one year.

items.text: If your daughter-in-law is not the wife of the heir, mourn her with only five months.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 適婦不爲舅後者，則姑爲之小功 — If the principal wife is not wife of the heir, the mother-in-law wears small merit for her.

items.text: Mourn your other sons (not the eldest) with one year's mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 爲衆子，不杖朞 — For other sons, wear the one-year unmounted staff mourning.

items.text: Mourn your other sons' wives with nine months' mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 衆子婦舊服小功，今請與兄弟子婦同，服大功九月 — For other sons' wives, formerly small merit; now request to wear great merit nine months like brothers' sons' wives.

items.text: Mourn your eldest grandson, the heir of the main line, with one year's mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 嫡孫，不杖朞 — For the principal grandson, unmounted staff one year.

items.text: Mourn your other grandsons with nine months' mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 庶孫，大功 — For other grandsons, great merit.

items.text: Mourn your great-grandson with three months' mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 曾孫，緦麻 — For great-grandson, thin hemp.

items.text: Mourn your brother with one year's mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 昆弟，不杖朞 — For brothers, unmounted staff one year.

items.text: Mourn your sister-in-law or brother-in-law with five months' mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 嫂叔舊無服...今請小功五月報 — Brother's wife and brother's younger brother formerly no mourning; now request small merit five months.

items.text: Mourn your uncle or aunt with one year's mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
items.quote: 世父母叔父母，不杖朞 — For father's older brothers, their wives, father's younger brothers, and their wives, unmounted staff one year.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制 · 總論 … 齊衰三月

items.text: Mourn your father for three years wearing cut sackcloth; sons and unmarried daughters alike.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 斬衰...父...女子子在室，爲父，衰三年 — For a father, cut sackcloth; an unmarried daughter also mourns her father three years.

items.text: When your father is dead, mourn your mother for three years in untrimmed sackcloth; treat a stepmother or adoptive mother as your own mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 齊衰三年...父卒則爲母，繼母如母，慈母如母 — For a mother after father's death, three years in untrimmed sackcloth; stepmother and adoptive mother are treated as mother.

items.text: Mourn your husband for three years in cut sackcloth.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 妻爲夫...衰三年 — A wife mourns her husband three years.

items.text: Mourn your eldest son for three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 母爲長子 — A mother mourns her eldest son three years.

items.text: When your father is still alive, mourn your mother for one year with the mourning staff.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 父在，爲母ㆍ妻 — While father lives, mourning for mother is one year.

items.text: Mourn your wife for one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 父在，爲母ㆍ妻 — While father lives, mourning for mother is one year; a husband also mourns his wife one year.

items.text: Mourn your grandparents for one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 不杖...祖父母 — For grandparents, no staff, one year.

items.text: Mourn your paternal uncles and aunts for one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 世父母，叔父母 — For father's elder and younger brothers and their wives, one year.

items.text: Mourn your brothers and sisters for one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 爲兄弟 — For brothers, one year.

items.text: Mourn your sons (other than the eldest) for one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 爲衆子 — For other sons, one year.

items.text: Mourn the head of the main line, and his mother and wife, for three months.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 丈夫婦人，爲宗子宗子之母妻 — All men and women mourn the lineage heir and his mother and wife three months.

items.text: Mourn your great-grandparents and great-great-grandparents for three months.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 服制 總論 齊衰三月
items.quote: 爲曾祖父母...爲高祖父母 — For great-grandparents and great-great-grandparents, three months.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論

items.text: Wear the mourning garment with breast piece, back panel, and side pieces when mourning a parent, as an expression of your sorrow.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Sangbok Jedochongnon
items.quote: 前有衰，後有負版，左右有辟領，孝子哀戚之心，無所不在。 — There is a front piece, a back panel, side pieces; the filial son's sorrow is everywhere.

items.text: When mourning a grandparent, include the breast piece, back panel, and side pieces in the mourning garment, as for any 齊衰 mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Sangbok Jedochongnon
items.quote: 今之行禮者，牽於楊說，雖於祖父母及妻喪，亦不用之，恐非禮意。當以《家禮》爲正。 — Those who practice rites now, influenced by Yang's theory, even for grandparents and wife's mourning do not use them; this is not the ritual intent. Should follow the Family Rituals.

items.text: When mourning your wife, include the breast piece, back panel, and side pieces in the mourning garment, as for any 齊衰 mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Sangbok Jedochongnon
items.quote: 今之行禮者，牽於楊說，雖於祖父母及妻喪，亦不用之，恐非禮意。當以《家禮》爲正。 — Those who practice rites now, influenced by Yang's theory, even for grandparents and wife's mourning do not use them; this is not the ritual intent. Should follow the Family Rituals.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 厥明五服之人各服其服入就位朝哭 … 三年內立後成服之節

items.text: Wear the mourning garment appropriate to your relationship to the deceased.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 五服之人各服其服 — Each of those in the five mourning grades wears his proper mourning garment.

items.text: During mourning for a parent, after encoffining eat only rice gruel, one handful morning and evening.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 父母之喪，旣殯，食粥，朝一溢米，暮一溢米 — In mourning for a parent, after encoffining, eat gruel: one handful of rice in the morning, one handful in the evening.

items.text: In one-year mourning, eat coarse food and drink water, abstaining from vegetables and fruit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 齊衰之喪，疏食水飮，不食菜果 — In one-year mourning, eat coarse food and drink water, not eating vegetables or fruit.

items.text: In nine-month mourning, abstain from vinegar and sauce.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 大功之喪，不食醯醬 — In nine-month mourning, do not eat vinegar or sauce.

items.text: In five-month and three-month mourning, abstain from sweet wine; you may drink wine and eat meat but do not join feasts or music.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 小功緦麻，不飮醴酒；五月三月者，飮酒食肉，不與宴樂 — In five-month and three-month mourning, do not drink sweet wine; those in five-month and three-month mourning may drink wine and eat meat, but do not join feasts or music.

items.text: If adopted as heir within three years of the death, begin mourning as at the first day, with hair unbound and mourning clothes assumed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 立後於三年之內，則其子追服之節，如袒髺髮成服，當一如初喪 — If the heir is established within three years, his observance of mourning should be like the first day: hair unbound, mourning clothes worn.

items.text: On the day of assuming mourning, do not set up a separate sacrificial table; the morning offering alone is proper.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Seongbok
items.quote: 今有設牲醴以祭者...成服盛祭，於禮無據 — Now some set out animal offerings and sweet wine... A sumptuous sacrifice on the day of assuming mourning has no basis in ritual.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 婦人帶麻 … 襲絰

items.text: Women must wear the prescribed mourning garments (hemp ropes and twisted belt) from the beginning of the rites.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 婦人亦有二苴絰與絞帶，以備喪禮。 — Women also have two hemp ropes and a twisted belt to prepare for mourning rites.

items.text: Bow to guests, individually to senior officials and collectively to lesser officials.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 主人拜賓，大夫特拜，士旅之。 — The master bows to guests, individually to senior officials and in groups to lesser officials.

items.text: If there is no female host, bow to female guests inside the inner door.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 其無女主，則男主拜女賓于寢門內。 — If there is no female host, the male host bows to female guests inside the bedroom door.
items.needs_role: male host when no female host present

items.text: If there is no male host, bow to male guests below the east steps.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 其無男主，則女主拜男賓于阼階下。 — If there is no male host, the female host bows to male guests below the east steps.

items.text: If the heir is a young child, an adult must hold him in mourning clothes and bow to guests on his behalf.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 子幼則以衰抱之，人爲之拜。 — If the son is young, someone holds him in mourning clothes and bows for him.

items.text: When elders sit, juniors must stand.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 尊長坐，卑幼立。 — Elders sit, juniors stand.

items.text: Together lift the body and move it to the hall.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 士擧，男女奉尸侇于堂。 — Men and women lift the body together and move it to the hall.

items.text: Put on the headband and waistband at the east side.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 襲絰于序東。 — Put on the headband and waistband at the east side.

items.text: When mourning a mother, put on the mourning cap (免) instead of tying the hair.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 母之喪，即位而免。 — When mourning a mother, upon taking position, put on the mourning cap instead of tying the hair.

items.text: Do not join the chief mourner in bowing to guests; take your positions.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 衆主人東卽位。 — The other masters go to their positions in the east.

items.text: Bow to all who assisted with the dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Soryeom (小斂), '婦人帶麻 … 襲絰'
items.quote: 主人降階，凡與斂之人，皆拜之。 — The master descends the steps and bows to all who took part in the dressing.
items.needs_role: those who assisted with the dressing

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 妻爲夫黨服 總 … 夫曾祖高祖

items.text: Mourn him with the highest mourning of three years, as for a lord.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 妻爲夫。傳：夫至尊也。 — Wife for husband; the commentary: the husband is most honorable.

items.text: Serve them as you would your own parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 婦事舅姑，如事父母 — A wife serves her father-in-law and mother-in-law as she serves her own parents.

items.text: Mourn them with the three-year mourning of unhemmed sackcloth.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 爲舅姑，並斬衰三年 — For father-in-law and mother-in-law, both wear unhemmed sackcloth for three years.

items.text: Mourn them with the nine-month mourning of coarser sackcloth.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 〈喪服〉大功：爲夫之祖父母 — For husband's grandparents, the nine-month mourning.

items.text: Mourn them with the three-month mourning of fine hemp.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 義服緦麻 — The obligatory mourning is fine hemp.

items.text: Mourn them as your own mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 繼母嫡母，與生母無異 — Stepmother and legal mother are no different from birth mother.

items.text: Wear mourning for his relatives as the code prescribes, usually one grade below his.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 夫之所爲兄弟服，妻皆降一等 — For what the husband wears for his brothers, the wife lowers one grade.

items.text: Even if he has died, keep the mourning due to his relatives because your bond was through him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 10: 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 屬從者，所從雖歿也服 — For those followed through, even if the one followed is dead, she still wears mourning.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂

items.text: Personally lift and move the body for the small dressing; do not leave it to hired hands.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 侍者盥手擧尸，男女俱扶助之。 — Attendants wash hands and lift the corpse; men and women all help.

items.text: Wear white cloth and the ring headband when you view the small dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 主人兄弟，白巾環絰以視斂 — The master and his brothers wear white cloth and ring headband when viewing the dressing.

items.text: Wrap the body but do not tie the shroud bands and do not cover the face, hoping for revival.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 未掩其面，蓋孝子猶俟其復生，欲時見其面故也。 — Do not cover the face, for the filial child still hopes for revival and wishes to see the face.

items.text: Do not bind the corpse tightly, because it may prevent revival.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 緊絞若此，是重絶生道也。 — Binding tightly like this greatly cuts off the way of life.

items.text: Do not cut off the small ties on the burial clothes.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 世割去小帶，誤矣 — The world's practice of cutting off the small ties is an error.

items.text: In the urgency of mourning, set aside the usual separation of men and women and work together to handle the body.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 喪事嚴急，男女滾同，所不得以避也。 — In the urgent matter of mourning, men and women mix together and cannot avoid it.

items.text: Move the offering table aside before the small dressing, and set a new offering afterward.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 設小斂牀布絞衾衣 … 遂小斂
items.quote: 遷置靈座西南，俟設新奠，乃去之。 — Move the spirit seat to the southwest; wait until a new offering is set, then remove the old.
items.conflict: offerings to the dead; violates the second commandment and forbids necromancy

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論

items.text: When mourning your father, carry a staff of bamboo.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 斬衰苴杖，用竹 — For a father, the staff is of bamboo.

items.text: When mourning your mother, carry a staff of paulownia.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 齊衰杖，以桐爲之 — For a mother, the staff is of paulownia.

items.text: While your father lives, do not carry a staff when mourning your mother, deferring to him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 父在爲母，不敢杖 — While the father is alive, do not presume to carry a staff for the mother.

items.text: As a son who is not the heir, do not take your place carrying a staff, deferring to the eldest son.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 庶子，不以杖卽位 — A common son does not take his position with a staff.

items.text: When your grandfather is present, do not take your place with a staff while mourning your father, deferring to him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 爲長子杖，則其子，不以杖卽位 — When one carries a staff for an eldest son, that son's son does not take his place with a staff.

items.text: While your parents live, do not carry a staff when mourning your wife, deferring to them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 爲妻，父母在，不杖 — For a wife, if parents are alive, one does not carry a staff.

items.text: Even if your mother-in-law is still alive, you may carry a staff mourning your husband.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 婦人，不爲主而杖者，姑在，爲夫，杖 — A woman who is not the principal mourner, if her mother-in-law is alive, for her husband carries a staff.

items.text: For your eldest son who has died, carry a staff of paulownia.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 母爲長子杖 — A mother carries a staff for her eldest son.

items.text: As a son who is not the heir, even while your father lives, you may carry a staff mourning your wife.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 庶子，父在爲妻，以杖卽位 — A common son, while his father is alive, for his wife takes his position with a staff.

items.text: If your grandfather does not preside over your father's funeral, you may carry a staff mourning your father.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 父不主庶子喪，則孫以杖卽位 — If the father does not preside over a common son's funeral, the grandson takes his position with a staff.

items.text: When mourning your father, wear sandals of straw.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 斬衰，菅屨 — For the highest mourning, straw sandals.

items.text: When mourning your mother, wear coarse shoes.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin, 常變通攷 卷九 · 成服 · 成服 · 喪服制度總論
items.quote: 疏衰，疏屨 — For the next mourning, coarse shoes.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 · 兄弟之子女同 … 三從兄弟姊妹同

items.text: Mourn your brother's son for one year, without the staff, as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 正服不杖朞。○〈喪服〉不杖：昆弟之子。 — Wear the principal mourning for a brother's son: one year without the staff.

items.text: Mourn your brother's son's wife for nine months as an associated garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 義服大功。○《圖式》：大功。 — Associated mourning, nine months, for a brother's son's wife.

items.text: Mourn your first cousin for nine months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 正服大功。○〈喪服〉大功：從父昆弟。 — Principal mourning, nine months, for a first cousin.

items.text: Mourn your first cousin's wife for three months, as a minor garment, though some traditions omit it.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 《會典》ㆍ《大典》：爲堂兄弟妻緦麻。 — For a first cousin's wife, wear the three-month hemp, per the Collected Statutes.

items.text: Mourn your great-uncle (grandfather's brother) for five months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 爲從祖祖父從祖祖姑，正服小功。 — For great-uncle and great-aunt, principal mourning, five months.

items.text: Mourn your brother's grandchild (your great-nephew) for five months, reciprocally.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 〈喪服〉小功：從祖祖父母，報。 — Five months' mourning is reciprocal for great-uncle and great-nephew.

items.text: Mourn your husband's great-uncle for three months as an associated garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 義服緦麻。○〈喪服〉緦麻：夫之諸祖父。 — Associated mourning, three months, for husband's great-uncle.

items.text: Mourn your father's first cousin for five months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 爲從祖父從祖姑，正服小功。 — For father's first cousin, principal mourning, five months.

items.text: Mourn your second cousin for five months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 正服小功。○〈喪服〉小功：從祖昆弟。 — Principal mourning, five months, for a second cousin.

items.text: Mourn your third cousin for three months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 正服緦麻。○〈喪服〉緦麻：族昆弟。 — Principal mourning, three months, for a third cousin.

items.text: Mourn your great-great-uncle for three months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 爲族曾祖父族曾祖姑，正服緦麻。 — For great-great-uncle, principal mourning, three months.

items.text: Mourn your great-great-uncle's son for three months as a principal garment.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服 10
items.quote: 爲族祖父族祖姑，正服緦麻。 — For great-great-uncle's son, principal mourning, three months.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制 · 大功九月 … 緦麻三月

items.text: Mourn for a deceased grandchild with the nine-month da gong garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲衆孫男女 — for all grandchildren

items.text: Mourn for a deceased paternal cousin with the nine-month da gong garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲從父兄弟姊妹 — for paternal cousins

items.text: Mourn for a deceased daughter-in-law with the nine-month da gong garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲衆子婦 — for daughters-in-law

items.text: Mourn for your husband's deceased grandparents with the nine-month da gong garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲夫之祖父母 — for husband's grandparents

items.text: Mourn for a child who died in childhood with reduced mourning: nine months for an older minor, seven months for a middle minor.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 子女子子...其長殤皆九月纓絰，中殤七月不纓絰 — sons and daughters who died young: for an older minor nine months with a corded headband, for a middle minor seven months without.

items.text: As an adopted son, mourn your biological brothers with mourning reduced by one grade.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲人後者於兄弟，降一等，報 — an adopted son reduces mourning for his brothers by one grade, and this is reciprocated.

items.text: As a married daughter, mourn your brothers with mourning reduced by one grade.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 女子子適人者，爲衆昆弟 — a married daughter mourns her brothers

items.text: If you hold a higher official rank than a deceased relative, reduce your mourning grade.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 大夫降其庶子 — a minister reduces mourning for his son by a concubine
items.conflict: All persons are equal before God; social rank should not reduce mourning duty.

items.text: Mourn for your maternal grandparents with the five-month xiao gong garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲外祖父母 — for maternal grandparents

items.text: Mourn for your maternal uncle with the five-month xiao gong garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲舅 — for mother's brother

items.text: If you are a son of a concubine and have become the family heir, mourn your birth mother with the three-month si ma garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 庶子爲父後者，爲其母 — a son of a concubine who is heir mourns his mother

items.text: Mourn for a deceased great-grandchild with the three-month si ma garments.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷九 · 服制 · 服制
items.quote: 爲曾孫玄孫 — for great-grandchildren and great-great-grandchildren

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 · 長子

items.text: Mourn your eldest son who is to succeed you with the three-year sackcloth, because he carries the lineage.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 父爲適子當爲後者，加服斬衰三年 — A father for his legitimate son who is to be his successor wears the three-year unhemmed sackcloth.

items.text: Mourn your eldest son with the three-year even sackcloth, whether or not your husband is alive.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 母爲嫡子當爲後者，加服齊衰三年 — A mother for her legitimate son who is to be her successor wears the three-year even sackcloth.

items.text: While your own father is alive, do not yet wear the three years for your eldest son; wait until you have become head of the family.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 父在則己未成適。父沒後，爲父後者，然後爲長子三年也。 — While one's father is alive, he himself is not yet the heir; only after his father is gone and he becomes the successor does he wear three years for his eldest son.

items.text: If your eldest son dies and a second son by your wife becomes heir, mourn him with the three years as the eldest son.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 第一子死，則取適妻所生第二長者立之，亦名長子 — If the first son dies, take the second eldest born of the wife and establish him; he is also called eldest son.

items.text: If you are a son who is not the heir, do not wear the three years for your eldest brother; mourn him only as a brother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 庶子不得爲長子三年，不繼祖也。 — A secondary son may not wear three years for the eldest son, because he does not continue the ancestral line.
items.conflict: Treats siblings unequally by birth; Galatians 3:28.

items.text: If a son by a secondary wife is made heir, do not mourn him with the three-year sackcloth as heir, but as a common son.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 父母於子... 將所傳重者非適，服之皆如庶子庶婦也。 — For parents toward a son, if the one to whom the succession is passed is not legitimate, they wear mourning as for a common son.
items.conflict: Treats children by mother's status; Deuteronomy 10:17.

items.text: Mourn an adopted son who is your heir with the full three years, as you would a born eldest son.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 夫旣繼體傳重而其服之也，徒以己出與否而異斬齊之制 — Since he has already succeeded and carries the succession, to differentiate mourning based on whether he was born of oneself...

items.text: If your daughter-in-law is married to a son who is not the heir, mourn her as a common daughter-in-law, not as the main one.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 長子
items.quote: 舅姑於婦，將所傳重者非適，服之皆如庶子庶婦也。 — For parents-in-law toward a daughter-in-law, if the one to whom the succession is passed is not legitimate, they wear mourning as for a common daughter-in-law.
items.conflict: Treats daughters-in-law unequally based on husband's status.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫承重則從服 … 夫兄弟

items.text: When your husband bears the weight of the line for his grandfather or great-grandfather, wear the three-year unhemmed sackcloth mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫承重則從服
items.quote: 夫爲祖若曾高祖承重，則從服斬衰三年

items.text: When your husband bears the weight of the line for his grandmother or great-grandmother, wear the three-year hemmed sackcloth mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫承重則從服
items.quote: 爲祖若曾高祖母承重，則從服齊衰三年

items.text: Even if your mother-in-law or grandmother-in-law is still alive, follow your husband in mourning his ancestors when he is the heir; your mourning is not the same as inheriting the main line.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫承重則從服
items.quote: 夫承重而其姑在，則妻雖從服，而不害爲庶婦 — When the husband is heir and his mother is alive, his wife follows mourning without ceasing to be a junior wife.

items.text: When your father-in-law dies, take over the ancestral sacrifices from your mother-in-law, for she retires and hands the rites to you.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫承重則從服
items.quote: 舅沒則姑老，是授祭事於子婦
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead are forbidden in Christianity; worship belongs to God alone (Lev 19:31; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: If the mother of the lineage heir is alive, do not wear mourning for his wife, for the mother remains the matriarch.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫承重則從服
items.quote: 宗子之母在，則不爲宗子之妻服

items.text: Do not wear mourning for your husband's brother; your relation is that of sister-in-law, not of mother or child.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫兄弟
items.quote: 夫之昆弟，何以無服也？其夫屬乎父道者，妻皆母道也。其夫屬乎子道者，妻皆婦道也。

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 大斂 · 大斂 · 不與人坐非時見乎母不及中門 … 殯廳長燈非禮

items.text: While in three-year mourning, live apart in the mourning hut, sit with no one, and do not enter the house to see your mother except at the set times.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 非時見乎母也，不入門。 — At improper times to see mother, do not enter the door.

items.text: For the whole mourning period, do not enter your wife's chamber.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 終喪不入妻室，稍知義理，不待防閑之嚴，而自不忍爲矣。 — For the whole mourning, do not enter the wife's chamber; understanding principle, one naturally cannot bear to do it without strict prevention.
items.conflict: 1 Cor 7:5: do not deprive one another except by mutual consent for a limited time.

items.text: Place the coffin and mourning hut outside the middle gate, so that the inner and outer quarters are not connected.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 古人殯於西階之上，設倚廬於庭中，皆在中門外。 — The ancients placed the coffin on the west steps, set up the mourning hut in the courtyard, all outside the middle gate.

items.text: Sleep outside in the mourning hut; only after three months return to your bedroom.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 居宿於外，三月而復寢。 — Dwell and sleep outside; after three months resume sleeping.

items.text: When your brothers leave after the encoffining, bow to them outside the gate.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 兄弟出，主人拜送于門外。 — When the brothers leave, the host bows and sends them off outside the gate.

items.text: If your mourning is light, you may go home after the encoffining, but come back to wail at the morning and evening offerings.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 旣殯雖歸，至朝夕朔奠，近者亦入哭。 — After the encoffining, even if they go home, at the morning and evening offerings and the first of the month, those nearby also enter to wail.

items.text: When mourning a dagong relative for nine months, do not enter the inner quarters for the first three months.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 大功布衰九月者，三月不御於內。 — For dagong mourning with cloth of nine months, for three months do not go in to the inner quarters.
items.conflict: 1 Cor 7:5: do not deprive one another except by mutual consent for a limited time.

items.text: Do not keep a lamp burning all night in the mourning hall; light torches only for the set tasks and extinguish them at dawn.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Dae Ryeom (大斂)
items.quote: 自襲至大斂，自啓至發引，爲燎以照，厥明滅之。殯宮長燈，恐非禮。 — From dressing to great encoffining, from opening to procession, make a torch to light, extinguish at dawn. A permanent lamp in the mourning hall is probably not ritual.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 · 曾祖父母 … 妻
