items.text: Wear the five-month cut sackcloth mourning for your great-grandparent; if you are a married-out woman, do not reduce it.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 正服齊衰五月。女適人不降。

items.text: For any ancestor of the fifth generation or higher whom you have personally served, wear the three-month cut sackcloth mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 五代以上，皆以三月爲斷。

items.text: Mourn the grandparents of your adoptive parent as if they were your own great-grandparents, wearing the proper mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 爲所後者之祖父母，若子。

items.text: If you are the legitimate heir succeeding to the ancestral line, wear the three-year unhemmed sackcloth for your great-grandfather and the three-year hemmed sackcloth for your great-grandmother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 嫡孫爲曾祖承重者，加服斬衰三年。爲曾祖母承重者，加服齊衰三年。
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatrous; this heavier mourning is tied to continuing the ancestral cult.

items.text: If you are the legitimate heir succeeding to the ancestral line, wear the three-year unhemmed sackcloth for your great-great-grandfather and the three-year hemmed sackcloth for your great-great-grandmother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 嫡孫爲高祖承重者，加服斬衰三年。爲高祖母承重者，加服齊衰三年。
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatrous; this heavier mourning is tied to continuing the ancestral cult.

items.text: Wear the one-year hemmed sackcloth with staff when your wife dies.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 義服杖朞。

items.text: When mourning your wife, if your father is alive, do not use the staff; if your mother is alive, do not perform the deep bow of grief.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 爲妻，父母在，不杖，不稽顙，母在，不稽顙。

items.text: If you are a distant kinsman whose mourning relation has ended, still wear the three-month cut sackcloth mourning for the main lineage heir when he dies, out of respect for the common ancestor.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 10, Mourning Rites: 曾祖父母 … 妻
items.quote: 宗人絶屬者，服大宗子齊衰三月，以尊祖也。

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 本宗服 · 本宗服 · 祖父母

items.text: Mourn your deceased grandparent for one year without a staff; if you are a daughter married out, do not reduce this mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 正服不杖朞。女適人不降。 — Correct dress is one year without staff. A woman married out does not reduce.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: If you hold high office and your grandparent was a commoner, still do not reduce the mourning; you dare not lower your grandparent.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 大夫爲祖父母爲士者。傳：不敢降其祖。 — A grand officer, for grandparents who were commoners: the Tradition says, he dare not lower his grandparents.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: If your father is dead, as the main-line heir you must take up the weight of the ancestor rites and wear three years' mourning for your grandfather.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 嫡孫父卒爲祖承重者，加服斬衰三年。 — The lineal grandson whose father is dead, bearing the weight for his grandfather, adds three years' unhemmed mourning.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: If your father is dead but your grandfather lives, mourn your grandmother for one year with a staff; after the year ends, continue in heart-mourning to complete three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 嫡孫父卒祖在爲祖母，正服齊衰杖朞。雖朞除，猶心喪三年。 — The lineal grandson, father dead and grandfather alive, for grandmother: proper dress is one year with staff. Though the year ends, still heart-mourning three years.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: If you became heir after your father's death and your grandmother later dies, you must wear three years for her.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 祖父卒而後爲祖母後者三年。 — He who becomes successor to his grandmother after his grandfather's death: three years.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: As heir, if your grandmother or great-grandmother dies while higher-ranking female ancestors still live, do not reduce the mourning because of them; wear it fully.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 姑不厭婦，婦人不主祭。已承先君之正體，無疑於服重也。 — A mother-in-law does not suppress a daughter-in-law; women do not preside over sacrifices. Having received the proper body of the former lord, no doubt about heavy mourning.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: When the heir dies during mourning, the next grandson must step in as presider over the sacrifices and continue the rites, and after the year is over, observe heart-mourning to the end of three years.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 使一孫攝主。若周旣除，當以素服臨祭，依心喪以終三年。 — Make one grandson the presider. After the year is over, in plain clothes approach the sacrifice, following heart-mourning to finish three years.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: If the main heir dies without a successor, the next grandson must step in as heir and continue the ancestral rites, so that the ancestors are not left without a successor.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 嫡孫亡無後，次子之後，可得傳祖重否？ — If the lineal grandson dies without heir, may the second son's son transmit the grandfather's weight?
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

items.text: If your father is disabled and cannot perform the mourning, you as the heir must take his place and wear the three-year mourning for your grandfather.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 本宗服, 祖父母
items.quote: 嫡孫繼統而代之執喪，義當然也。 — The lineal grandson continues the line and in his place performs the mourning; this is right.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous; Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting the dead.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷十 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 妻爲夫黨服 · 夫兄弟之妻 … 被出者爲夫黨服

items.text: Wear the xiaogong mourning for your husband's brother's wife.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 娣姒婦，報。傳：何以小功也？以爲相與居室中，則生小功之親焉。 — Sisters-in-law: xiaogong, mutual. Why? Because living together in the same household gives rise to xiaogong kinship.

items.text: Wear xiaogong mourning for your husband's paternal aunt and sisters, without reduction even if they are married.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 義服小功。適人者不降。夫之姑姊妹。 — Xiaogong for husband's aunts and sisters, no reduction if married.

items.text: Wear dagong mourning for your husband's paternal uncle and aunt.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 爲夫之世父母叔父母。 — For husband's elder uncle, younger uncle, and their wives.

items.text: Wear the one-year mourning without staff for your husband's brother's children; if a daughter has married out, wear dagong.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 夫之昆弟之子（註：男女皆是。）大功：爲夫之昆弟之婦人子適人者。 — Husband's brother's children (both male and female); for husband's brother's daughter married out, dagong.

items.text: Wear sima mourning for your husband's paternal cousin's wife.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 爲夫之從父昆弟之妻。 — For husband's paternal cousin's wife.

items.text: Wear sima mourning for your husband's great-uncles and great-aunts.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 夫之諸祖父母（註：諸祖父者，夫之從祖祖父母。） — Husband's various grandparents (i.e., his great-uncles and great-aunts).

items.text: Wear sima mourning for your husband's maternal grandparents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 夫之諸祖父母（註：諸祖父者，夫之外祖父母。） — Husband's various grandparents (i.e., his maternal grandparents).

items.text: Wear sima mourning for your husband's maternal aunt.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 爲公子之從母，緦麻。 — For husband's maternal aunt, sima.

items.text: If you are put away but keep faith, wear mourning for your husband's kin as usual.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 妻爲夫黨服
items.quote: 若守信者，雖被出，而其心則不改也... 似當服夫黨如常。 — If faithful, though divorced, her heart unchanged... she should wear mourning for husband's kin as usual.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶

items.text: At the small dressing, bare your shoulder and bind your hair with hemp when mourning your father.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 男子斬衰者，袒括髮 — Men in unhemmed sackcloth bare and bind hair.

items.text: When mourning your mother, after moving her body to the hall, replace the hemp hair-binding with the cloth 免.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 爲母括髮以麻，免而以布 — For mother bind hair with hemp, and use 免 with cloth.

items.text: If you are a male relative in 齊衰 or lighter mourning, bare your shoulder and wear the 免 at the small dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 齊衰以下，至同五世祖者，皆袒免 — Those in 齊衰 and below, up to those sharing a fifth-generation ancestor, all bare and wear 免.

items.text: As a woman in mourning, bind your hair in the 髽 style at the small dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 婦人髽于室 — Women bind their hair in 髽 in the room.
items.needs_role: any female mourner (wife, daughter, mother, etc.)

items.text: As chief mourner, after leaning on the corpse, wear the twisted belt (絞帶).
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 主人袒括髮絞帶 — The chief mourner bares, binds hair, and wears twisted belt.

items.text: As a mourner in 齊衰 or lighter, wear the cloth belt (布帶) after the small dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 衆主人布帶 — The other mourners wear cloth belts.
items.needs_role: male mourners in 齊衰 or lighter

items.text: When moving the corpse or carrying the coffin, bare your shoulder and leap in grief.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 動尸擧柩，袒而踊 — When moving the corpse or carrying the coffin, bare and jump.

items.text: As a woman, do not bare your shoulder when the corpse is moved.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 婦人不宜袒 — Women should not bare.

items.text: When you take part in dressing the corpse, bare your shoulder.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 凡斂者袒 — All who dress the corpse bare.

items.text: If you are an orphaned boy in charge of the household, you must wear the 免 even though you are not yet capped.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 若爲孤子而當室，則雖童子亦免 — If he is an orphan in charge of the house, even a boy must 免.

items.text: As chief mourner, bare your shoulder at the three prescribed times: before placing rice in the mouth, after the small dressing, and when the great dressing begins.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 袒括髮免髽于別室 … 主人絞帶衆主人布帶
items.quote: 袒有三，將含而袒...小斂旣卒而袒...大斂將始而袒 — Baring has three times: before placing rice, after small dressing, at start of great dressing.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷八 · 小斂 · 小斂 · 厥明執事者陳小斂衣衾 … 設奠

items.text: Prepare the deceased's own clothes for the lesser dressing; if he had many, choose as needed and do not use all.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8 · 小斂
items.quote: 據死者所有之衣，隨宜用之，若多則不必盡用。 — Use the deceased's own clothes, selecting as appropriate; if many, you need not use them all.

items.text: Use a lined coverlet and binding bands—three horizontal, one vertical—to wrap the body for the lesser dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8 · 小斂
items.quote: 衾用複者 ... 絞橫三縱一以細布或綵 — Use a lined coverlet; use three horizontal and one vertical band of fine cloth or colored silk.

items.text: Cover the corpse with a special shroud (yi qin) after the lesser dressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8 · 小斂
items.quote: 自小斂以往用夷衾 — From the lesser dressing onward, use the yi qin.

items.text: Set up an offering table with food and drink for the deceased.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8 · 小斂
items.quote: 設卓子于阼階東南，置奠饌及盞注于其上，巾之 — Set a table southeast of the east steps, place the offering food and cup with pourer on it, and cover it with a cloth.
items.conflict: Offering food to the dead is not a Christian practice; the dead cannot eat.

items.text: Before serving the offering, wash your hands and clean the cups.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 8 · 小斂
items.quote: 設盥盆帨巾各二于饌東 ... 所以洗盞拭盞也 — Provide two basins with towels east of the offering; use them for washing hands and for washing and wiping the cups.
items.conflict: Ritual purification for offerings to the dead is not required in Christian worship.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Mourning Rites: death, dressing, encoffining, assuming mournin
heading: 常變通攷 卷七 · 襲 · 襲 · 不作佛事 … 告廟

items.text: Do not perform Buddhist rites for your deceased parent, for that treats him as wicked and cannot benefit him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 不作佛事
items.quote: 世人親死而禱浮屠，是不以其親爲君子，而爲積惡有罪之小人 — When people's parents die and they pray to Buddha, they treat their parents not as gentlemen but as wicked sinners.

items.text: If your father honored Buddha, do not use Buddhist rites for him; wait three years before removing his sacred images.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 不作佛事
items.quote: 勿用浮屠，可也，至於家舍所敬形像，必須三年而後改 — Do not use Buddhist rites; as for the sacred images in the house, you must change them after three years.

items.text: When you come to mourn before the host has completed mourning dress, wear plain deep clothes, wail fully by the corpse, bow to the spirit seat, and offer incense.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 襲
items.quote: 主人未成服，而來哭者，當服深衣。臨尸哭盡哀，出拜靈座，上香再拜 — Before the chief mourner has completed mourning dress, those coming to wail should wear the deep garment; wail fully by the corpse, bow at the spirit seat, and offer incense.

items.text: Then condole with the bereaved chief mourner: stand opposite him, wail fully together, and he responds with weeping but no words.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 襲
items.quote: 遂弔主人，相向哭盡哀。主人以哭對無辭 — Then condole with the chief mourner, wail fully facing each other; the mourner responds with weeping but no words.

items.text: If an elder comes to condole even before you have put on mourning dress, you must go out to receive him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 襲
items.quote: 親始死，雖不敢出見賓，然有所尊者，不可不出 — When a parent has just died, though you dare not go out to see guests, if there is someone to be honored you must go out.

items.text: Announce a death in the family at the ancestral temple.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 告廟
items.quote: 家有喪，亦當告也 — When there is a death in the family, you must also announce it.
